title: Totem: Object-Centric 3D Memory for World-Consistent Video Generation
title_zh: Totem：以对象为中心、支持世界一致性视频生成的三维记忆框架

paragraphs.en: Generating coherent videos grounded in a unified underlying world remains a major challenge, particularly under large viewpoint changes, where existing methods often struggle to maintain stable representations of individual objects. To this end, we introduce Totem , an object-centric 3D memory framework for world-consistent video generation. Totem first represents each selected object as a persistent 3D memory aligned to a shared world frame, assigning it a dedicated state. Based on these memories, we design a dual-stream 3D conditioning architecture that combines object memories with scene geometry for target-view synthesis. Moreover, these object memories constrain the model’s attention with 3D structural information, thereby preserving object surfaces and relative spatial layouts. Extensive experiments on world-generation and object-centric benchmarks demonstrate that Totem generates videos depicting a more object-consistent 3D world under challenging camera trajectories, while supporting versatile applications.
paragraphs.zh: 生成基于统一底层世界的连贯视频仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在视角发生较大变化时，现有方法往往难以维持单个物体的稳定表示。 为此，我们提出了 Totem——一个以物体为中心、用于生成世界一致视频的三维记忆框架。 Totem 首先将每个选定的物体表示为与共享世界坐标系对齐的持久性三维记忆，并为其分配一个专属状态。 基于这些记忆，我们设计了一种双流三维条件架构，将物体记忆与场景几何结构结合，用于目标视角的合成。 此外，这些物体记忆通过三维结构信息约束模型的注意力，从而保留物体表面和相对空间布局。 在世界生成和以物体为中心的基准测试中进行的大量实验表明，Totem 能够在具有挑战性的相机运动轨迹下生成描绘更一致三维世界的视频，同时支持多样化的应用。

paragraphs.en: Video generation is becoming a fundamental capability for a wide range of visual applications, from content creation to interactive and immersive experiences. Recent image-to-video models provide a flexible way to generate realistic videos from a single reference image [ 2 , 11 , 48 , 20 , 36 ] . To support a user-defined camera trajectory, the generation process is further conditioned on camera information such as poses [ 42 ] and ray representations [ 12 , 1 ] . Although these methods improve viewpoint controllability, they mainly learn it as image-space motion, making it difficult to maintain a consistent world under complex viewpoint changes.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成正成为各类视觉应用的一项基础能力，涵盖内容创作到互动式和沉浸式体验。 近期的图像到视频模型提供了一种灵活的方法，能够根据单张参考图像生成逼真的视频 [ 2 , 11 , 48 , 20 , 36 ] 。 为了支持用户自定义的相机轨迹，生成过程还会进一步以相机信息（如姿态 [ 42 ] 和射线表示 [ 12 , 1 ] ）为条件。 尽管这些方法提升了视角的可控性，但它们主要将这种可控性学习为图像空间中的运动，导致在复杂视角变化下难以维持一致的世界观。

paragraphs.en: Recently, increasing efforts have explored world-consistent video generation through explicit 3D memory. These methods attempt to guide video generation by rendering target-view observations from scene-level point clouds [ 49 , 4 , 29 , 16 , 54 , 43 , 52 ] , but the resulting memories usually cover only the geometry visible in the input views. When the camera moves beyond the observed regions, the rendered conditions provide limited support for maintaining stable objects in the generated world. As a result, existing methods still face several object-level challenges under complex scenarios with occlusions, object disappearance and reappearance, and strong scale variation. 1) Object-Scene Alignment Drift. Without coordination between object and scene, a target object may be wrongly hidden or misaligned with surrounding structures. 2) Single-Object Surface Inconsistency. Scene-level memory does not reliably associate generated pixels with the same physical object surfaces. Consequently, object appearance and geometry may become inconsistent. 3) Inter-Object Layout Instability. Spatial relations among individual objects are not explicitly modeled by existing conditions, leading to unstable layouts.
paragraphs.zh: 近期，越来越多的研究通过显式 3D 记忆探索了与世界一致的视频生成方法。 这些方法试图通过从场景级点云渲染目标视角的观察结果来指导视频生成 [49, 4, 29, 16, 54, 43, 52]，但生成的记忆通常仅覆盖输入视角中可见的几何结构。 当相机移动超出已观察区域时，渲染出的条件对维持生成世界中稳定物体所提供的支持十分有限。 因此，现有方法在包含遮挡、物体消失与重现以及强烈尺度变化的复杂场景下，仍面临若干物体层面的挑战。1) 物体-场景对齐漂移。 若物体与场景之间缺乏协调，目标物体可能会被错误地隐藏或与周围结构错位。2) 单物体表面不一致性。 场景级记忆无法可靠地将生成的像素与同一物理物体的表面关联起来。 因此，物体的外观与几何结构可能会出现不一致。3) 物体间布局不稳定性。 现有条件并未显式建模单个物体之间的空间关系，导致布局不稳定。

paragraphs.en: Addressing these challenges requires more than view-dependent scene guidance. What is needed is a persistent object-level representation that can carry object information across viewpoints while retaining its geometric context within the scene. This naturally motivates an object-centric 3D memory, which provides a stable spatial reference for individual objects within a shared 3D world. This allows object properties to remain associated with the same underlying entities, while helping preserve inter-object layouts and object-scene alignment.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduce Totem, an object-centric 3D memory framework for world-consistent video generation from a single image along user-specified camera trajectories. Starting from the reference image, each selected object is instantiated as a 3D memory, comprising a canonical representation with surface anchors and an object-to-world transform that places it in a shared world coordinate system. To translate these memories into view-aligned guidance for generation, Totem adopts a dual-stream conditioning design that couples instance-level appearance and geometry with scene-level spatial structure, providing a stronger 3D prior for world-consistent synthesis. Furthermore, the 3D structure stored in memory enables surface correspondence and spatial relation modeling. We therefore propose object-centric attention in canonical and world spaces to exploit this structural information during generation: canonical-space surface binding associates repeated observations with canonical surface anchors; world-space relation preservation incorporates relative object transforms into cross-object attention.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 Totem——一个以物体为中心的三维记忆框架，用于根据单张图像和用户指定的相机轨迹生成与世界保持一致的视频。 从参考图像出发，每个选定的物体都会被实例化为一个三维记忆，包含一个带有表面锚点的规范表示以及一个将物体置于共享世界坐标系中的物体-世界变换。 为了将这些记忆转化为与视图对齐的生成引导，Totem 采用了一种双流条件设计，将实例级的外观和几何信息与场景级的空间结构相结合，从而为生成世界一致的内容提供更强的三维先验。 此外，存储在记忆中的三维结构还支持表面对应关系和空间关系建模。 因此，我们提出了在规范空间和世界空间中以物体为中心的注意力机制，以便在生成过程中利用这些结构信息：规范空间中的表面绑定将重复观察到的内容关联到规范的表面锚点；世界空间中的关系保持则将物体间的相对变换纳入跨物体注意力中。

paragraphs.en: We extensively evaluate Totem on both world-level and object-level benchmarks, including WorldScore [ 7 ] , ConsIDVid-Bench [ 44 ] , and an out-of-distribution benchmark. Totem achieves state-of-the-art performance in world-consistent generation. Dual-stream view guidance and object-centric attention further bring strong improvements in cross-view object appearance and geometry under challenging scenarios. In addition, Totem supports applications such as camera-controllable video generation, long-range video generation, and spatial video editing.

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We introduce Totem, an object-centric 3D memory framework for world-consistent video generation, which maintains persistent 3D object states.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Totem，这是一种以物体为中心、用于生成世界一致视频的三维记忆框架，能够维持持久的三维物体状态。

paragraphs.en: We propose a memory-guided generation architecture that transforms object-centric 3D memories into view-aligned priors and object-aware attention signals, stabilizing object appearance, geometry, and spatial relations across generated views.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种基于记忆的生成架构，该架构将面向对象的三维记忆转化为与视图对齐的先验知识和感知对象的注意力信号，从而在生成的各个视图中稳定对象的外观、几何形状和空间关系。

paragraphs.en: Totem achieves competitive performance across different tasks, demonstrating its potential as a world-consistent video diffusion model.
paragraphs.zh: Totem 在不同任务中均展现出具有竞争力的性能，证明了其作为世界一致视频扩散模型的潜力。

paragraphs.en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction. Recent feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods have shifted 3D perception from optimization-heavy pipelines toward direct prediction from sparse observations. They recover camera parameters, depth, pointmaps, tracks, or global 3D structure through a unified forward pass [ 39 , 21 , 37 , 41 , 23 , 19 ] . These methods provide efficient geometric priors and scene-level structure for downstream vision tasks. Moving beyond holistic scene reconstruction, object-centric 3D methods further focus on modeling individual objects from images, capturing detailed geometry and appearance [ 15 , 47 , 31 , 6 , 46 , 55 , 17 ] . While they provide object-level 3D representations for reconstruction and rendering, they are primarily designed as static object assets rather than temporal memory for video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 前馈式三维重建。 近期的前馈式三维重建方法已将三维感知从依赖大量优化的流程转向基于稀疏观测的直接预测。 它们通过一次统一的前向传播恢复相机参数、深度、点云图、轨迹或全局三维结构 [ 39 , 21 , 37 , 41 , 23 , 19 ] 。 这些方法为下游视觉任务提供了高效的几何先验和场景级结构。 除了整体场景重建，以物体为中心的三维方法更进一步专注于从图像中建模单个物体，捕捉其精细的几何形状和外观 [ 15 , 47 , 31 , 6 , 46 , 55 , 17 ] 。 尽管它们为重建和渲染提供了物体级的三维表示，但它们主要被设计为静态的物体资产，而非用于视频生成的时序记忆。

paragraphs.en: Video generation models. Diffusion video models established the foundation for modern video generation by incorporating temporal modeling into the diffusion framework [ 14 , 13 , 33 ] . Building on this foundation, subsequent latent diffusion models (LDMs) improved generation efficiency and quality, while enabling conditional video synthesis [ 3 , 10 , 2 , 5 , 51 ] . More recently, large-scale video foundation models, often built on Transformer architectures, have further strengthened spatio-temporal modeling, visual fidelity, and motion realism through extensive training data [ 48 , 20 , 11 , 36 ] . Overall, these models provide strong generative priors for realistic video synthesis and controllable motion.

paragraphs.en: Spatial memory for video generation. To improve spatial consistency, a growing body of work augments video diffusion pipelines with explicit spatial memory structures that maintain a 3D scene representation during generation. A representative strategy is to lift observed or generated RGB frames into scene point clouds using estimated depth, accumulate them into a persistent 3D cache, and render view-aligned conditions along the target camera trajectory [ 49 , 4 , 29 , 16 , 54 , 52 ] . Beyond global scene caches, recent methods explore locally retrieved geometric memories from historical views [ 43 ] , while others construct persistent spatial memory directly in the diffusion latent space [ 40 ] . Such memory-based approaches have demonstrated clear improvements in multi-view coherence, as the accumulated 3D representation anchors newly generated frames to a shared geometric scaffold [ 45 ] . Nevertheless, most existing memory designs organize 3D information at the scene level, without assigning persistent states to individual objects. Our work instead queries object-centric 3D memories to guide target-view synthesis, supporting long-range camera motion while preserving object-level consistency.

paragraphs.en: Although view guidance specifies what should appear at each target viewpoint, it does not explicitly model object states in canonical and world spaces. In more challenging scenarios, the same object may be regenerated independently across frames, leading to surface texture drift and changes in relative object positions. To address this limitation, we impose 3D constraints derived from object memory on attention in the ControlNet branch within these two complementary spaces. In canonical space, visible tokens are bound to canonical surface anchors and refined through attention, allowing surface information to persist. In world space, relative displacement, rotation, and scale extracted from object-to-world transforms are converted into relation-aware attention biases, helping preserve inter-object layout under camera motion.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管视图引导规定了每个目标视角应呈现的内容，但它并未显式地对标准空间和世界空间中的对象状态进行建模。 在更具挑战性的场景中，同一对象可能在不同帧中被独立地重新生成，从而导致表面纹理漂移和对象相对位置的变化。 为了解决这一局限性，我们在 ControlNet 分支中，于这两个互补的空间内，对注意力施加了源自对象记忆的三维约束。 在标准空间中，可见的标记会与标准表面的锚点绑定，并通过注意力机制进行优化，从而使得表面信息得以保留。 在世界空间中，从对象到世界的变换中提取出的相对位移、旋转和缩放会被转换为关系感知的注意力偏差，有助于在相机运动时保持对象间的布局。

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. For 3D memory construction, we use Qwen3.5-122B-A10B [ 28 ] to identify the primary rigid objects and extract their boxes, SAM3 [ 26 ] to obtain masks, and VGGT-Omega [ 38 ] to reconstruct a reference-view scene pointmap from the first frame. Each masked object is reconstructed as a canonical Gaussian with SAM3D [ 31 ] , aligned to the scene with RANSAC [ 9 ] and scale-constrained Umeyama initialization [ 34 ] , and then sampled into surface anchors with farthest point sampling (FPS) [ 27 ] . For training, we initialize the frozen video backbone from the Wan2.2-I2V-A14B checkpoint [ 36 , 35 , 18 ] and adopt a two-stage optimization schedule. We first train the camera and dual-stream control pathways, and then freeze the camera branch and enable the object-centric attention modules. Complete training and inference settings are provided in Appendix .
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。 对于三维内存构建，我们使用 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B [ 28 ] 识别主要刚性物体并提取其边界框，使用 SAM3 [ 26 ] 获取掩码，并使用 VGGT-Omega [ 38 ] 从第一帧重建参考视角的场景点云图。 每个被掩码的物体都通过 SAM3D [ 31 ] 重建为规范高斯分布，利用 RANSAC [ 9 ] 与场景对齐，并通过具有尺度约束的 Umeyama 初始化 [ 34 ] 进行调整，随后使用最远点采样（FPS）[ 27 ] 将其采样为表面锚点。 在训练阶段，我们从 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 检查点 [ 36 , 35 , 18 ] 初始化冻结的视频主干网络，并采用两阶段优化方案。 我们首先训练相机和双流控制路径，然后冻结相机分支并启用以物体为中心的注意力模块。 完整的训练与推理设置见附录。

sents.zh: 对于三维内存构建，我们使用 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B [ 28 ] 识别主要刚性物体并提取其边界框，使用 SAM3 [ 26 ] 获取掩码，并使用 VGGT-Omega [ 38 ] 从第一帧重建参考视角的场景点云图。

sents.en: Each masked object is reconstructed as a canonical Gaussian with SAM3D [ 31 ] , aligned to the scene with RANSAC [ 9 ] and scale-constrained Umeyama initialization [ 34 ] , and then sampled into surface anchors with farthest point sampling (FPS) [ 27 ] .
sents.zh: 每个被掩码的物体都通过 SAM3D [ 31 ] 重建为规范高斯分布，利用 RANSAC [ 9 ] 与场景对齐，并通过具有尺度约束的 Umeyama 初始化 [ 34 ] 进行调整，随后使用最远点采样（FPS）[ 27 ] 将其采样为表面锚点。

sents.en: For training, we initialize the frozen video backbone from the Wan2.2-I2V-A14B checkpoint [ 36 , 35 , 18 ] and adopt a two-stage optimization schedule.
sents.zh: 在训练阶段，我们从 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 检查点 [ 36 , 35 , 18 ] 初始化冻结的视频主干网络，并采用两阶段优化方案。

sents.en: We first train the camera and dual-stream control pathways, and then freeze the camera branch and enable the object-centric attention modules.
sents.zh: 我们首先训练相机和双流控制路径，然后冻结相机分支并启用以物体为中心的注意力模块。

sents.en: Complete training and inference settings are provided in Appendix .
sents.zh: 完整的训练与推理设置见附录。

paragraphs.en: Training data. We train on two open-source real-world datasets, RealEstate10K [ 58 ] and DL3DV [ 24 ] . RealEstate10K mainly contains real-estate videos with indoor residential scenes and some outdoor environments, while DL3DV provides diverse real-scene videos with richer camera motion. After filtering unsuitable samples and constructing fixed-length windows, we retain about 40K clips from each dataset, resulting in roughly 80K training clips. All clips are resampled to 15 fps, split into 81-frame windows, and center-cropped to 720p.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation. We evaluate Totem from two aspects: (1) world consistency and (2) object consistency. For (1), we adopt WorldScore [ 7 ] , which consists of 2,000 static test examples spanning diverse worlds, including indoor and outdoor, photorealistic and stylized scenes. Each example provides an input image and a camera trajectory. The metrics evaluate generation controllability and quality, and the overall score summarizes the final performance. For (2), the public subset of ConsIDVid-Bench [ 44 ] is selected to evaluate object consistency. It is an object-centric video benchmark with 370 videos drawn from public datasets and synthetic sequences that evaluates both perceptual and geometric consistency at the object level.
paragraphs.zh: 评估。 我们从两个方面对 Totem 进行评估：(1) 世界一致性和 (2) 对象一致性。 对于 (1)，我们采用 WorldScore [ 7 ]，它包含 2,000 个静态测试示例，涵盖多样化的世界，包括室内和室外、照片级真实和风格化的场景。 每个示例都提供一个输入图像和一个相机轨迹。 这些指标用于评估生成的可控性和质量，而总分则总结了最终表现。 对于 (2)，我们选择 ConsIDVid-Bench [ 44 ] 的公开子集来评估对象一致性。 这是一个以对象为中心的视频基准数据集，包含从公开数据集和合成序列中选取的 370 个视频，用于评估对象层面的感知一致性和几何一致性。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, to evaluate Totem’s generalization in complex settings, we introduce an out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmark including 400 videos, constructed from RealEstate10K and DL3DV. paragraphs.zh: 此外，为了评估 Totem 在复杂环境中的泛化能力，我们引入了一项分布外（OOD）基准测试，其中包含 400 个视频，这些视频由 RealEstate10K 和 DL3DV 构建而成。 该 OOD 基准测试被划分为四种以物体为中心的挑战类型，每种类型包含 100 个片段：目标物体因遮挡或移出画面而消失；与附近或重叠的相似物体产生混淆；在视角大幅变化后重新观察同一场景；以及在长距离相机运动下出现尺度或分辨率退化。

paragraphs.en: To emphasize object-level validation, we first evaluate the selected objects using three metrics from ConsIDVid-Bench (Object Similarity, Chamfer Distance, and MEt3R). The masks for the selected objects are obtained by reapplying the mask-extraction stage of our memory construction pipeline to the generated videos. For Object Similarity, we follow the benchmark’s DINO-based feature comparison, while matching each generated object to the reference observation with the closest camera viewpoint. For Chamfer Distance and MEt3R, complete frames are used to estimate multi-view geometry and feature correspondences, after which the same object masks are applied to retain object-specific points and features before aggregation. In addition, we report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS to measure overall visual fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 为了强调对象级别的验证，我们首先使用 ConsIDVid-Bench 中的三个指标（对象相似性、Chamfer 距离和 MEt3R）来评估所选对象。 通过再次将我们的记忆构建流程中的掩码提取阶段应用于生成的视频，可以获得所选对象的掩码。 在对象相似性方面，我们遵循该基准测试中基于 DINO 的特征比较方法，同时将每个生成的对象与视角最接近的参考观察结果进行匹配。 对于 Chamfer 距离和 MEt3R，我们使用完整的帧来估计多视角几何结构和特征对应关系，然后应用相同的对象掩码以保留特定于对象的点和特征，再进行聚合。 此外，我们还报告了 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 指标，以衡量整体的视觉保真度。

paragraphs.en: World consistency. We compare Totem with six top methods on the WorldScore benchmark, including two representative 3D memory methods, Voyager and Spatia [ 16 , 54 ] , and four strong world-generation baselines, Mirage [ 40 ] , EonWorld, WorldScape-0.2 [ 25 ] , and UniWorld-View [ 57 ] . As reported in Table 1 , Totem achieves the highest WorldScore-Static score on this benchmark. In particular, it leads on camera control, 3D consistency, and photometric consistency. These results indicate that Totem provides effective object-level spatial support for world-consistent generation.

paragraphs.en: Object consistency. We further compare Totem with five 3D scene-aware video generation baselines for object-centric consistency. The comparison set spans three representative paradigms: 3D-cache-guided view synthesis, including ViewCrafter and GEN3C [ 49 , 29 ] ; persistent scene-level memory methods, including Voyager and Spatia [ 16 , 54 ] ; and geometry-memory hybrid generation, represented by WorldStereo [ 52 ] , which combines camera-guided video synthesis with 3D geometric memory. As reported in Table 2 , Totem achieves the best results across the object-centric metrics. Higher Object Similarity reflects better instance-specific appearance, while lower Chamfer Distance and MEt3R correspond to more stable shape and cross-view geometry.

As shown in Table 3 , introducing projected point-cloud guidance enhances generation quality over the camera-branch baseline, indicating the benefit of explicit 3D conditions. paragraphs.en: (a) Camera-Controllable Video Generation
paragraphs.zh: (a) 可相机控制的视频生成

paragraphs.en: By leveraging its object-centric 3D memories, Totem supports various video-related applications.
paragraphs.zh: 通过利用其以物体为中心的 3D 记忆，Totem 支持各种与视频相关的应用程序。

paragraphs.en: Camera-controllable video generation. As explained in Sec. 3.2 , our dual-stream conditions provide view-aligned guidance for both scene geometry and object appearance at each target viewpoint, thereby enabling camera-controllable video generation. In Table 4 , we compare Totem with five mainstream image-to-video methods with camera conditions [ 1 , 56 , 22 , 53 , 32 ] on the OOD benchmark. We evaluate camera controllability with absolute pose errors (RotErr and TransErr), local motion errors (RPE-T and RPE-R), and global trajectory error (ATE). The results demonstrate that Totem achieves stronger camera controllability and spatial stability in the generated videos. Figure 4 (a) further presents two examples with the Move Right and Push In camera motions. In both cases, the high-quality generated frames follow the predefined camera trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 可相机控制的视频生成。 如第 3.2 节所述，我们的双流条件为每个目标视角的场景几何和物体外观提供与视角对齐的引导，从而实现可相机控制的视频生成。 在表 4 中，我们在 OOD 基准上比较了 Totem 与五种支持相机条件的图像到视频主流方法 [1, 56, 22, 53, 32]。 我们通过绝对姿态误差（RotErr 和 TransErr）、局部运动误差（RPE-T 和 RPE-R）以及全局轨迹误差（ATE）来评估相机的可控性。 结果表明，Totem 在生成的视频中实现了更强的相机可控性和空间稳定性。 图 4(a) 进一步展示了“向右移动”和“推进”两种相机运动下的两个示例。 在这两种情况下，高质量生成的帧都遵循了预定义的相机轨迹。

paragraphs.en: 3D-aware video editing. Having demonstrated the effectiveness of object-centric 3D memories for consistent video synthesis, we further extend Totem to object-level video editing. Given a reference image, users edit the selected object in the first frame using an image-editing model. The corresponding 3D memory is then updated and used to generate the edited video. In Figure 4 (b), we provide two examples of object change and object removal, where Totem successfully propagates these edits across viewpoints, producing visually coherent videos while preserving the surrounding scene and the spatial relationships among unedited objects.
paragraphs.zh: 支持三维感知的视频编辑。 在证明了以物体为中心的三维记忆对于生成连贯视频的有效性之后，我们进一步将 Totem 扩展至物体级别的视频编辑。 给定一张参考图像，用户可以使用图像编辑模型对第一帧中选择的物体进行编辑。 随后，对应的三维记忆会被更新，并用于生成经过编辑的视频。 在图 4(b) 中，我们提供了两个物体更改和物体移除的示例，Totem 成功地将这些编辑效果传播到不同视角，从而生成了视觉连贯的视频，同时保留了周围场景以及未编辑物体之间的空间关系。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present Totem, an object-centric 3D memory framework for world-consistent video generation. Totem generates coherent videos with stable spatial structure and object appearance across different viewpoints. This capability further supports controllable, editable, and long-horizon video generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved visual fidelity, world consistency, and object consistency under challenging camera trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 Totem，一个以物体为中心、用于生成世界一致视频的三维记忆框架。 Totem 能够生成在不同视角下具有稳定空间结构和物体外观的连贯视频。 这一能力进一步支持了可控、可编辑且长期有效的视频生成。 大量实验表明，在具有挑战性的相机运动轨迹下，Totem 提升了视觉保真度、世界一致性和物体一致性。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes the complete memory construction procedure, which is performed before video denoising. In addition to the object RGB and scene-depth streams consumed by the dual-stream ControlNet, it retains object identities, canonical coordinates, and object-to-world transforms as geometric metadata for object-centric attention.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 总结了完整的记忆构建流程，该流程在视频降噪之前执行。 除了双流 ControlNet 所使用的物体 RGB 和场景深度流之外，它还保留了物体身份、规范坐标以及物体到世界的变换，作为以物体为中心的注意力机制的几何元数据。
